scope: Delivery architecture and Namesakes/Birthdays tab separation. No new biography or history research.
decisions: One prepared month/day JSON per language and country; complete 366-day export generated in dist only, never committed.
Load today for the selected country/language; load adjacent days or another country only when chosen.
Namesakes contains exact local/international given-name bearers only. Birthdays is independent of the selected name.
Birthday selection belongs to a country/day; duplicate it in every country JSON so future local ranking may differ. Current fame ranking remains unchanged.
Retain all annual profiles, birthday candidates, population snapshots, provenance, private cache, notes and generated research queues.
